name: Wedding Cake (3.5g) - Classic Cuts
description:
Private Stock is now Classic Cuts - A selection of classic and modern classic varieties curated from a lineage of tried and true genetics. Always hand-trimmed, always grown indoors. Available in 3.5g & select 1g strains. 

_____

Wedding Cake is the cross of Triangle Kush and Animal Mints. This delectable treat is rich with tangy sweet earth and pepper. Enjoy this double dose of dense dankness with care, as certain farms have noted extremely high THC content.
